title: Welcome to Vitality Logistics: New Joiner Guide

pages.heading: Welcome
paragraphs: Welcome to Vitality Logistics. Since 2009 we have moved sea, road and air freight across the GCC from our head office in Business Bay and our warehouse in Jebel Ali.
This guide covers your first week: your badge, your systems and who to call when something goes wrong. Keep it handy.

pages.heading: Your first day
paragraphs: Head office is on the 12th floor of Bay Square. Collect your badge from reception (Anna will look after you). Your badge opens the turnstiles and the lifts.
Your employee ID is printed on your badge in the format VL-0000. You'll need it for HR forms, IT and the payroll portal, so learn it by heart.

pages.heading: IT and your accounts
paragraphs: Your email, files and calendar all run on VitalNet. Your login is your first and last name: firstname.lastname. Webmail: mail.vitality-logistics.ae
IT gives you a first-login password on day one. It expires after 7 days, so change it during your first week.
Locked out? Call the IT help desk on 04 555 0214 (ext. 214) with your employee ID and department, and they will reset it over the phone.
Everything else (laptops, printers, access) goes through a FixIt ticket.
